snippet.title: Broken Sword - The Smoking Mirror: Reforged | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🌴 Wishlist on Steam: https://revsoft.games/WishlistSmokingMirror
🌴 Collector's Editions coming soon to Kickstarter: https://revsoft.games/SmokingMirror-Kickstarter

A substantial enhancement of the multi award-winning original, Broken Sword - The Smoking Mirror: Reforged offers stunning 4K visuals and remastered audio, as George Stobbart and Nico Collard are drawn into a terrifying tale of ruthless drug cartels, Mayan mysteries, and a conspiracy that threatens to unleash destruction on the world.

🌴  Broken Sword - The Smoking Mirror: Reforged
🌴  Baphomets Fluch - Die Spiegel der Finsternis: Reforged
🌴  Les Chevaliers de Baphomet - Les Boucliers de Quetzalcoatl: Reforged
🌴  Broken Sword - La Profezia dei Maya: Reforged
🌴  Broken Sword - Las Fuerzas del Mal: Reforged
